definitions.explanation: Individual pieces that make up a whole, such as machine components, model kit parts, or body parts in beauty/fashion contexts.

examples.japanese: パーツ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧パーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦プラモデル→プラモデル：07328_puramoderu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧パーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ピンセット→ピンセット：09756_pinsetto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てた→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧。
examples.english: I assembled the small model kit parts with tweezers.

notes:
USAGE:
パーツ is commonly used for mechanical/electronic components, model kit pieces, and in beauty/fashion contexts (e.g., facial features referred to as パーツ). It tends to be used for components that are assembled into a larger whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧: to assemble parts
- パーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace parts
- ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧パーツ: replacement parts
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧パーツ: facial features
- ⟦ネイル→ネイル：25891_neiru⟧パーツ: nail art decorations

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧ is the standard Japanese word for machine parts/components, often used in industrial contexts. パーツ is more casual and broader in use.
